x: Looking at the handicap section, it was no great surprise to find that our B team had returned the lowest aggregate time. The individual handicap prize went to the Highgate Centurion, A.
The subscription is seven shillings for twelve monthly copies (H.M. Forces, five shillings), from A.

Further tributes were then paid to Stan by Alf McSweeney whose club promoted the race in which Stan set the new records, by Ernest Neville who also presented to Stan the Fowler Dixon Style award which he won in the A.A.A.
